_doc: LOCKED brand preset. Every format inherits these tokens. Change only on purpose — every past and future video uses them.
name: signature

sfx._doc: Sound effects live in engine/sfx (generated by scripts/make_sfx.py; replace any file with your own .wav of the same name). Mapping of events -> sounds is in build.mjs (SFX section); tune levels here.

grade._doc: House colour grade applied in the rough cut (ffmpeg filters). Teal shadows, warm skin mids, cool highlights (bluer sky), S-curve, vibrance. Per job: job.json "grade": "none" or a custom filter string.

displayFonts._doc: English display fonts for stylish titles/kickers. Keys are what plan.json uses in "font".

layout9x16._doc: Rule-of-thirds safe layout for 9:16 (user's reference picture). Fractions of canvas. Text hook band top, eyes on the middle line, captions lower band. Nothing important outside safe.

sfxPolicy._doc: Every sound belongs to a visual event. Captions, jump-cuts and emphasis punches are silent. Booms only on big reveals.
